title: GSD ↔ Beads bridge
summary: Locks the loosely-coupled integration model between GSD (plan + autonomous executor) and Beads (durable tracker) via a naming convention, with no bidirectional sync daemon.
notes: Manifest-declared ADR with precedence 0 (highest). Document encodes multiple locked decisions: (1) GSD owns plan + executor, Beads owns tracker; (2) no bidirectional sync daemon; (3) every gsd task in PLAN.md carries a `bead:` reference; (4) executor performs claim/note/close around each task; (5) mapping table: project root→Decision, ROADMAP entry→Milestone, phase→Epic, PLAN task→Story; (6) reviews and verification logs are gsd artifacts, not bead rows; (7) per-task atomic commits captured as bead notes, not separate beads; (8) cumulative labels required (initiative + strategic + layer + type). No explicit `Status: Accepted` header, but manifest authoritatively classifies as ADR.
